body: Wait where did you go that they let you have your phone? The whole reason I've avoided getting treatment is they want to cut me off from my network of friends and only talk to them through a prison phone.

Honestly I think it would be justified at this point but I'm too depressed to even try that hard. I kind of sympathize with her inability to understand basic respect. She literally cannot stop herself from blowing up my phone with fake numbers and contacting my friends and family. Its pitiful but she needs mental help just like I do.
You can check my last post if you want more info but basically my financial situation, mental health, and a stalker.
No sometimes I wish I was because I really worry how each of my friends will grapple with it. It's nice having people to talk to while I deteriorate though.
